result.instructions:
Apple Reminders on this Mac, synced through iCloud to the user's devices. find_reminders and list_lists read; pass a reminder's id and version to update_reminder or delete_reminder. Times are local to GMT: due and start take 2026-10-21 (all day) or 2026-10-21T09:00, and a due time adds an alert then. urgent makes that alert ring like an alarm and needs a due time; repeat and early_alerts need a due date. Tags are native, written without #. Subtasks are one level deep (parent_id); sections divide a list. Lists marked shared are seen by other people: confirm with the user before adding to or changing them, and assign with assigned_to. Deleted reminders go to Recently Deleted; list_deleted and restore_reminder bring them back.

The user chooses which of these tools are offered, in the Tools tab of the Apple Reminders MCP settings window (opened by opening the app). A tool named here that is not in your tool list is turned off there.
